assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's nine curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit, each read in full with its front matter: the active_provisional CORNERED_MOUSE_KYOICHI_OTOMO_MONOGRAPH.md (13,987 bytes) and the active_provisional CM-U01, U02, U04, U05, U06, U07, U09 and U10 deep readings (about 444 KB together), over the supplied witness CM-JP-AIO2020-LOCAL; CM-S01 enters only through the monograph. The historical U06 proposed model, the project ledgers and the corpus readiness review are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence. The items' own labels and the project's withheld operational release are inputs, not conclusions; the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: From the CM-U01 marriage and report bargain through the CM-U10 hospital breakup, snow pursuit and ring offer, with the CM-S01 welcome as reported by the monograph. States are split at the located gaps (six months after U01, two months inside U06, half a year before U07, six months before U10), at Imagase's U06 and U09 departures and at the U10 breakup; his late recognition of Imagase is never projected backward.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Located mechanisms: a preference for responding and for attributing initiative to others (U01 O003/O011, CM-CL-001), alongside a capacity to act when loss or replaceability becomes concrete (U02 O026-O033; U06 O038); kindness as pleasure and protection from rejection, given a remembered family history (U07 O004); fear of dependence on Imagase in a world where Imagase could leave (U06 O022); and the U05 plan that uses consideration as an exit and misfires (U05 O003-O004). Not B: the readings say the source 'does not require choosing one motive' for his kindness (U07), that 'neither total transformation nor no development explains all the evidence' (U10), and that affection does not predict ethical consistency; he refuses an affair to protect Tamaki and then breaches that protection (U10 O049 and after), and the evidence does not say which commitment wins in a new triangle. Not D: the mechanisms are conditioned on loss, replaceability and gendered expectations, located page by page, and carried with counterevidence in a dedicated monograph.

Each unit records entering state, located changes and an exit freeze: marriage, report blackmail and divorce, then the six-month ellipsis (U01 O027/O038); the first intimacy (U02 O033); the café rejection, Imagase's departure and the two-month gap (U06 O018/O028/O033); the half-year sequel at 31 as a new section chief (U07 O006-O007); the accepted breakup, grief and new intimacy with Tamaki (U09 O047/O068/O074-O076); and the six-month separation, the hospital breakup and the snow pursuit (U10 O015/O114-O128/O140). Not A: the final state rests on one negotiation and the monograph's account of the CM-S01 welcome, and the readings flag the 29-to-31 age jump as a state gap. Not C: states and transitions are located with anchors and the late recognition is never projected backward.

Extensive first-person captions plus located spoken forms: キスだけ and his blackmail caption (U01 O002), 人が好い (U01 O012), the life-expectancy retort (U02 O007), 'different world' (U04 O016), 俺が好きでお前とメシ食ってる and おいで (U07 O028/O042), 岡村さん and the narrow no-girlfriend wording 彼女 rather than 恋人 (U07 O014-O015), the incomplete apology through pauses (U09 O062), the third-time warning and cooler public speech (U10 O146/O151) and 業 (U10 O111). Not B: few spoken lines are quoted, there is no line inventory, and the inner doubles are narrated devices rather than speech. Not D: register is named and tied to recipient and situation.

Repeated routine across units: cleaning and solitary ease (U01 O037-O038), the shopping outing (U01 O019), the ready meal alone (U02 O022), lounging, laundry and easy dinners (U05 O001), office desk, distraction and overtime (U06 O033/O037), gift planning and a promotion (U07 O011/O014), commuting and lunches (U09 O003/O005), instant coffee and practical worries about parents and insurance (U10 O056/O109), and chips before dinner (monograph on S01). Not B: his work is fragments without a competence account, and the readings give no conditioned account of his routine. Not D: routine recurs across many units with locators.

The evidence explains why his treatment changes with the person and the stakes. With women he accommodates and waits for direction (Chikako, U01 O028-O029; asking Tamaki's permission, U10 O012-O013); with Imagase he is blunt, sometimes harsh or violent, and then apologetic (U02 O005/O018/O026; U07 O028/O036-O037). He names that gendered difference himself (U05 O002; U07 O029). Loss changes his response to Imagase from refusal to pursuit (U06 O028-O046; U10 O136-O140). Public concealment of the private relation recurs (U02 O004; U07 O015; U10 O159). Uncertainty is bounded: the Natsuki and Tamaki obligations stay asymmetric (U06 O046, CM-INF-025), the readings treat his family memory as his own account, and transfer to a new partner is open. Not A: one witness and no held-out test. Not C: the account discriminates by gender, intimacy and threatened loss, not only by scene.

He is the focal consciousness in every curated unit, with first-person captions, inner speech and comic doubles (U01 O002/O017; U02 O011/O040; U05 O002/O004; U06 O040/O047; U07 O043-O045; U09 O024/O076; U10 O079/O096/O108-O112), including the self-accounts the readings test against his conduct. Not A: the readings call his self-accounts interested, the doubles narrated devices, and the S01 welcome gives no interior. Not C: his reasoning at the decisive choices (the café, the pursuit, the hospital breakup) is directly available.

A located range with partial triggers: refusals and objections (U01 O009/O016), striking Imagase and the mistaken jealous knockdown (U02 O005/O026-O028), collar-grabbing (U02 O018), the proposal to stop (U04 O031), the café rejection (U06 O018), the exclusivity demand (U06 O046), the cruising-venue dismissal and apology (U07 O036-O037), immediate acceptance of the U09 breakup (O047), forceful restraint over Imagase's refusals (U10 O075-O077), the snow pursuit and the third-time warning (U10 O140/O146). Not B: why he accepts the U09 breakup but pursues in U10 is explained only after the fact, and the frozen U06 rival rule found no eligible case (CM-PA-006 NON_DISCRIMINATING). Not D: replaceability and concrete loss are located triggers.

Located weighing and self-judgment: the household-price rationale (U01 O010), the affair called 'wrong anyway' while it continues (U02 O029), recognizing his gaze at a coworker as harassment (U07 O013), passing an uncorroborated inference as fact (U07 O034), asking whether he waited for Imagase to give up (U09 O047), weighing a delayed breakup or marriage plus affair against prompt clarity as 'least bad' (U10 O099), the seated breakup in which he cannot ask Tamaki to wait (U10 O114-O124) and accepting Nogami's condemnation (U10 O131). Not B: stated principles yield under renewed attachment in two located cases (U02; U10 O049 then breach), and the readings say affection does not predict ethical consistency. Not D: explicit weighing between options is located.

His own play is a handful of located instances: the life-expectancy retort (U02 O007), tugging Imagase's cheek and the banana-and-crocodile joke (U06 O014/O035), the pet comparison (U07 O011) and jokes about coping (U10 O148). The comic doubles (U05; U09; U10 O080/O109) are the narrative's device for his interior, not his social play. Not C: no recurring recipient-directed practice is analyzed. Not E: the instances recur across units.

The curated readings cover every unit of the supplied witness in which he acts (CM-U01, U02, U04-U07, U09, U10) with page-level observations and exit freezes; U03 and U08 are uncited by design, and CM-S01 enters through the monograph. Not A: one witness; the Reboot-only story, other editions and adaptations are outside the boundary, and the S01 welcome has no curated reading on this row. Not C: his appearances are covered, not sampled.

Affirmative controls are located: 'no agency' would be false, given the initiated confrontations, pursuit and intimacy (U01 O012/O021/O026; U02 O018-O033; U04 O013-O039); the hotel attack rests on a wrong premise (U02 O028); the frozen U06 rival rule closed NON_DISCRIMINATING (U10 test closure); his U09 disavowal is overturned by grief without being erased (O051/O068); his exclusivity demand leaves his own Natsuki obligation unresolved (U06 O046); and his own wait signal bounds the reversed case (U04 O037; U10 O083). Not A: retrospective and from one witness. Not C: the controls are specific and decisive.

Claims carry page and observation locators; each unit has a timestamped exit freeze; gaps are located (six months, U01 O038; two months, U06 O033; half a year, U07 O007; six months, U10 O015); his knowledge is ordered (he learns Tamaki's parentage at U09 O006; he recognizes Imagase as a former lover only after the departure, U09 O076). Not A: the readings flag the age jump to 31 as a gap. Not C: ordering and anti-backdating are explicit.

conditions: Illustrative written lines only, never presented as quotation or as Japanese line imitation, at a declared state.
Register by recipient: accommodating politeness with women and at work; blunt, sometimes harsh then apologetic speech with Imagase; incomplete declarations under emotional pressure.
No acoustic delivery, and no completed love declarations where the sampled states give pauses or past tense.
scenario_readiness.note: First-person captions and located spoken forms constrain register and function; few spoken lines are quoted.

conditions: Before predicting, fix the located state, the person, what he stands to lose, and whether a woman's expectations or Imagase's are in play.

Supported response families: accommodation and waiting for direction with women; blunt objections followed by apology with Imagase; initiative when loss or replaceability becomes concrete; accounts that place initiative on others.
Abstain on which bond he chooses in a new triangle, on strangers, on a first-meeting script and on any final-state policy after the ring offer.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One declared state inside CM-U01-U10, using only what he knows at that point; the six-month, two-month and half-year gaps separate states and are never crossed silently.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Imagase in their existing relationship, a woman he is married to or dating (as Chikako, Natsuki or Tamaki), or a coworker; anyone else only as a separate, lower-confidence case.
setting_constraints: Contemporary Japanese office and domestic life as depicted.
No transfer of intimate-partner conduct to strangers.
No Reboot-only story, other edition or adaptation material.

scenario_readiness.note: A narrow bounded extrapolation over sampled relationships; the decisive commitment ordering is not established.

conditions: Only the sampled ordinary contexts: domestic routine with Imagase, office small talk and outings with a partner.

known_limits.statement: Which commitment wins when a woman's claim and Imagase's conflict is not discriminated; he refuses an affair to protect Tamaki and then breaches it.
His accounts of passivity, of his father and of others' initiative are his own and are repeatedly contradicted by his conduct.
The post-reunion state has one negotiation and one home encounter; the project's corpus review withholds a final-state behavioral model.
The frozen U06 rival rule found no eligible U07-U10 case and supports no claim either way.
An unvoiced manga gives written register only; no acoustic delivery.
The historical U06 proposed model and the project ledgers are not curated on this subject, so their rule text was not used as evidence.
Conduct with strangers, in unfamiliar institutions and in his actual work beyond fragments is not established.
No independent or held-out validation exists; the readings' tests are heterogeneous same-author adjudications, not an accuracy sample.
